# T-3: Move workflow hooks

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement workflow plugin prepare.post and finalize-cleanup.post hooks that share plugin-owned services with commands and provide non-blocking flow integration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3, R4, R5, AC3, AC5, AC12, AC13, AC14, AC16, and AC17 are covered.
- prepare.post handles linked issue board status movement when flowIntegration is enable.
- prepare.post receives newly written flow state after flow.json exists.
- finalize-cleanup.post extracts board idea candidates from a durable spec/issue-log path and returns plugin-owned follow-up text or data.

## Implementation Notes
Hook code should call services directly instead of spawning `senti workflow`. Hook run business failures stay warnings/follow-ups.

## Test Strategy
Plugin repo tests cover hook context mapping, flowIntegration enable/disable behavior, board/gh failure degradation, issue-log candidate extraction, and follow-up output.
